description: This file defines a configuration class for interfacing with Stability AI's image generation API. It handles parameter mapping from OpenAI-compatible prompts to Stability-specific API requests, constructs request URLs, validates environment variables like API keys, and transforms responses into a format compatible with OpenAI's conventions. The class supports multiple Stability models, manages environment setup, and explicitly indicates that multipart/form-data requests are used.

classes.name: StabilityImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for interacting with Stability AI's image generation API, supporting parameter mapping, environment validation, URL construction, and response transformation.

methods.name: str _get_model_endpoint(self, model: str)
